Language: Mastery of complex SQL and the ability to translate business logic into code-based data schemas. Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure digital measurement is aligned with reporting, analysis, and optimization needs. Support personalization and experimentation efforts with audience analysis, measurement planning, test readouts, and insight generation. Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to automate repeatable work, improve workflows, and strengthen analytics practices. Support evolving measurement needs tied to organic growth, content performance, and emerging AI-driven traffic sources. Who You Are You are a strong critical thinker who knows how to move from question to analysis to recommendation. You do not stop at producing a report, you look for what is meaningful, what may be wrong, and what action should follow. You can reason through ambiguity and make sound decisions when the answer is not obvious. You catch your own errors and challenge outputs that do not make sense. You are comfortable working independently and do not need highly prescriptive direction to make progress. You communicate clearly and can explain your thinking, assumptions, and conclusions with confidence. You value rigor, accuracy, and strong analytical judgment. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Familiarity with SEO measurement, content performance analysis, and digital growth strategies. Experience in environments that are automating parts of the analytics workflow. Exposure to measuring and interpreting emerging traffic patterns, including AI-driven traffic sources. Experience evaluating or working with analytics tagging QA tools. Power BI experience is preferred. What Success Looks Like In this role, success means more than delivering reports on time. It means producing work that is accurate, well-reasoned, and useful. It means identifying issues early, asking the right questions, and helping the business make better decisions with confidence. It means bringing a high standard of analytical rigor to reporting, tagging, testing, and performance analysis, while continuing to improve how the work gets done. Why Join Us This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in how digital performance is measured and improved. You will work on a broad mix of analytics, measurement, optimization, and experimentation challenges, and you will help shape a more scalable, data-driven approach as our capabilities continue to evolve.

Strong expertise in Java / Spring Boot - microservices, REST API design, Spring Security, and Hibernate / JPA. Proven proficiency in React.js - component architecture, state management (Redux / Context API), hooks, and performance optimisation.
